The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
廠商/產品：Microsoft / Internet Explorer
KEV 收錄日：2026-05-20｜修補期限：2026-06-03
必要處置：Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
勒索活動關聯：未知/否
